item.title: Called Home and Back: A Mother’s Return to Service
item.description: Even as a kid, I knew I wanted to serve in the Air Force. I never wanted anything more, except to one day be a mother. I guess I just never thought about how the two would work together.

item.title: USS Delbert D. Black Departs Israel Following Port Visit
item.description: MANAMA, Bahrain (Feb. 1, 2026) – Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Delbert D. Black (DDG 119) departed Eilat, Israel, following a scheduled port visit, Feb. 1.

item.title: 807th TMC G8 Boot Camp sharpens financial readiness for Army Reserve leaders
item.description: The 807th Theater Medical Command hosted a G8 Boot Camp in Ogden, Utah, Jan. 13–15, to strengthen Army Reserve leaders’ financial management skills. The training focused on simplifying complex funding regulations, improving audit readiness and helping units better plan, resource and execute missions, ensuring continued readiness across the command.

item.title: Airmen complete water survival training at Fairchild AFB
item.description: Airmen assigned to the 141st Air Refueling Wing conducted water survival training Jan. 29, 2026, strengthening essential skills needed during a catastrophic event in an open ocean environment.

item.title: U.S.-Kenyan partnership advances security cooperation
item.description: Members from U.S. Africa Command joined U.S. AFRICOM senior leadership, U.S. Air Force Gen. Dagvin Anderson, commander, U.S. AFRICOM; and U.S. Army Command Sgt. Maj. Garric Banfield, command senior enlisted leader, U.S. AFRICOM; U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau; Chargè d’Affaires Susan Burns; and Kenyan Defence and state officials at the construction site for a new runway expansion and airfield infrastructure project Jan. 29, 2026, in Manda Bay, Kenya. item.title: 111th Contingency Response Squadron conducts inaugural drill weekend at Fairchild AFB
item.description: FAIRCHILD AIR FORCE BASE, Wash. — The 111th Contingency Response Squadron conducted its first scheduled drill weekend Jan. 29, 2026, at Fairchild Air Force Base, marking an initial step in preparing the newly formed unit for rapid air base operations worldwide.

item.title: NAF Misawa Sailor Shares Cultural Exchange During Sapporo Snow Festival
item.description: A Sailor from Naval Air Facility Misawa (NAFM) participated in a community relations homestay with an English tutor, gaining firsthand experience of Japanese home life on February 2.

item.title: MUCM Jeremy Bustillos Pinning Ceremony
item.description: Master Chief Musician Jeremy Bustillos, assigned to the U.S. 7th Fleet Band, receives his Master Chief insignia during his pinning ceremony at the Fleet Theater, aboard Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka.

item.title: 75th Anniversary of the Korean War, February 1951
item.description: Seventy-five years ago, United Nations Command forces were advancing below the Han River to regain contact with and destroy Chinese forces and regain the initiative in Operations Roundup and Ripper.
